title: Skin-innervating glutamatergic neurons modulate aging.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: no PMCID, no open full text, no supplement, no NCBI links (GEO/SRA/BioProject), no Zenodo/Dryad hits; text-mined accessions are only antibody RRIDs (research resource identifiers). Two GEO keyword searches (Nefh, skin, aging, Vglut2, fibroblast) returned 0 series.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about the study design comes from the abstract: mouse denervation, Nefh deletion in Vglut2+ neurons, glutamate treatment, Cdk5 and Slc1a3 mechanism experiments.

a1_downloadable.note: No deposited dataset found: no GEO/SRA links, no supplement listing, no repository hit on the DOI (checked via tools). Paper is paywalled with no full text in Europe PMC.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not checkable; the study is mechanistic mouse genetics (collagen staining, senescence markers) with no labelled table described in the abstract.

a5_enough_rows.note: Row count unknown; mouse cohort experiments are typically tens of animals per group, far below 400.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: no accessible dataset was found for this mechanistic mouse study.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use skin gene-expression profiles from young, old and nerve-cut mice to predict skin biological age.
plain_idea.train_on: Would need per-sample skin expression profiles from the paper's mice; number of samples unknown and no deposited data found.
plain_idea.predict: Chronological age or aging state (young/aged/denervated), known from the experimental design.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Could test whether nerve loss mimics an aging expression signature, but the data needed is not publicly available.

ml_idea: None viable: mechanistic mouse genetics paper with no deposited omics or tabular data found.
